result.keyword: What's the best CRM for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **HubSpot CRM** as the best starting point. It's relatively easy to use, has a generous free version, and can grow with your business.

However, depending on how your team manages customers and sales, there are a few strong alternatives.

## My top 5 CRM recommendations

![HubSpot + Outbound Best Practices: How to Build a Predictable Pipeline Engine](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/fRaXjaIhlPuB-R-vp4pPeoGZlftvdgXSxyn6Q2rF42Kvv67ncid10g7lK3I8Ts0KBOUtWU1e_TFh69Ct3Yd7iXz5hetANX31x3M_throOc-8gj_ptcYrP0lMRBY1bi8qNHq1cblhhZaZ0YHkqql9Vi2haPe6jLaATcrIrrFWSWPloM1A0RgNH3M1Ze3FRXoV?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. HubSpot**

(Best overall)

Free plan available

- Very easy to learn.
- Contact and company management.
- Sales pipelines and task reminders.
- Email tracking and marketing integrations.

Best for: Small teams wanting an all-round CRM without much complexity.

[Explore HubSpot](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm)

---

![HubSpot vs Pipedrive: Which CRM is best for your business in 2026?](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/0TS7rBi8gDmW5AAPYL2fOvggpvV8soxoVlnjqt7rzOj686bFyLDcGbU5nKqrHfnRMbI3xIEUn7DStFDQ6-dnYAWpV3oK-vS7N7dkrv36YZ3K3mHeNQT7_eVOIQytuGq7L2KHOhPGvt_2h598_akpfIaD3C8RBMU6jMyfkm5v7u57dpeAIW5jjyVxZI3yvNRq?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Pipedrive**

(Best for sales teams)

From approximately A\$19/user/month

- Excellent visual sales pipeline.
- Tracks leads and opportunities.
- Follow-up reminders.
- Easy to understand and manage.

Best for: Teams focused on winning new business and managing sales opportunities.

[Explore Pipedrive](https://www.pipedrive.com/)

---

![Zoho CRM | CompareCamp.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/rP2gtcV7Nlyy6nXUMOQjzyN_wQygL4xaXQMp2d5k-DoSGEQMsEN3hNJ0WNTyKAitlOjia4fZYdphTCioyhHisHXlu36u8iQl1HSsfanhh1kEZHqS68G9jkpPxXqg-dHYtj48gIqS7_vCEJPZlinwqT9TxWpB9AntTVPUjoCPxYTyNW38E7xr6UJ6QSvz6_wN?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho CRM**

(Best value)

Free for up to 3 users; paid from approximately A\$22/user/month

- Highly customisable.
- Sales automation.
- Reporting and analytics.
- Integrates with other Zoho applications.

Best for: Businesses wanting more functionality without a huge software bill.

[Explore Zoho CRM](https://www.zoho.com/crm/)

---

![Freshsales – AI-Powered CRM for Efficient Sales & Customer Management – Daidu.ai](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/y7Vb4xAcRAAEuqjagQXpFAF7AnuXMUElBxy4BgPXr8eZYF7Dkte6UvmlzH7N7Gng8CLjCWbvU78ky87jsrjvYxdASFZf0fX5TJAm3axZjmliiRYYmBFh9H4s49unQfi71zpX0ByRdXwVVL50YsRCn7JH7nOSk0tgkqnFMggeUC_Qb730HNfnItPlsuAKqMt-?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Freshsales**

From approximately A\$15/user/month

- Built-in phone and communication tools.
- Lead scoring.
- Sales automation.
- Useful reporting.

Best for: Teams that make lots of calls and manage incoming leads.

[Explore Freshsales](https://www.freshworks.com/crm/sales/)

---

![10 Best Simple CRMs Of 2026 – Forbes Advisor](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/soJJipRKXs3hn32HRFfKQCN2mjxe1ms55aq4Xm2CeaSMul_8E6VpMzHFhMUJK5wSAoECSudTX15KSQ8MX7aA7R-n8RpX3Rl3wE7McfIpbmO0Fj1pffvvGptkxv1Daq1q7M-zo9jK4RIP-LC4GhqELvEM_UNxqBYtv_ndJWXTSBQ1x7lSopuLGO33DXMbCHKx?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. monday CRM**

From approximately A\$19/seat/month

- Highly visual interface.
- Sales and project tracking.
- Custom workflows.
- Good team collaboration.

Best for: Teams managing customer relationships alongside projects and operations.

[Explore monday CRM](https://monday.com/crm)

Indicative Australian pricing, generally based on annual billing. Confirm current pricing and seat requirements before purchasing. ## Which one would I choose?

| Your priority | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Best all-round CRM | HubSpot |
| Sales and lead management | Pipedrive |
| Lowest-cost flexibility | Zoho |
| Phone calls and lead follow-up | Freshsales |
| CRM + project management | monday |
